generations.text: Leila Alvarez contacted support because the Aero 2 overheats on the dock since 2025-12-27. It is a High priority case and the status is currently Working. The agent offered a refund of $240.00. The customer confirmed order ORD-16270 and asked for a callback. The knowledge base notes that Aero 2 units carry a 24-month warranty from the purchase date.
